senses.gloss:
[ऋच्-थक्] 
__1 Wealth. 
__2 (Especially) property, possessions, effects (left at death); see रिक्थ. 
__3 Gold. 
-Comp. 
-आदानः an inheritor, heir. 
-ग्रहणम् receiving or inheriting property. 
-ग्राहः an inheritor or receiver of property. 
-भागः 
__1 division of property, partition. 
__2 a share, inheritance. 
-भागिन्, -हर -हारिन् m. 
__1 an heir. 
__2 a co-heir.
